rounding_policy: Prose figures may be rounded for readability if the stated figure is within 5% (relative) of the true value, or within 0.5 percentage points when the value is itself a percentage, AND the rounding does not change the sign, the direction of a change, a ranking, or which side of a stated threshold the value falls on. Words like 'about'/'roughly' are welcome but not required inside that band. A figure outside the band, or one that changes sign/direction/ranking, is a misstatement. Structured numeric output (the JSON) is NOT covered by this policy: it must meet each check's explicit tolerance.

commentary:
Data quality: all cross-checks pass (subtotals, gross profit, operating income, net income, balance sheet), so the figures below are as exported with no unresolved mismatches.

- **Revenue 195,898 in Jun 2026, -6.0% vs May 2026 (208,351).** May 2026 was the highest month in the export, so this decline starts from a peak. Revenue is -0.5% vs the prior 6-month average (196,946) and +2.8% vs Jun 2025 (190,556). Usage Fees fell 6.3% to 166,782, and Professional Services, SKU Profiling and Partnership Income are all zero in Jun 2026.
- **Gross margin 70.2%, up from 67.0% in May 2026 (+3.1 pp).** That matches the prior 6-month average of 70.2% but is 4.2 pp below Jun 2025 (74.3%). TTM gross margin is 69.5%.
- **Total operating expenses (as exported) 468,182, -2.2% vs May 2026.** The largest category movement is Finance & Admin, which went from 15,243 to -993, mainly because Bad Debts went from 12,935 to -1,806. Events & Conferences rose by 17,971 to 29,295, while Partnerships Commission fell by 9,000 to 1,800 and Partner Marketing fell by 8,395 to 4,020.
- **Lines that dropped out:** Federal & State Taxes and Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous are zero in Jun 2026. Professional Fees has been zero since Apr 2026 (last non-zero: Mar 2026, 3,773), and Advisory Services has been zero since Feb 2026 (last non-zero: Jan 2026, 2,500).
- **Net income -330,756 in Jun 2026, the 6th consecutive negative month; TTM -3,089,780.** Net income was negative in 17 of 18 months. The only positive month, Dec 2025 (534,551), was positive only because of non-operating items. Excluding them it is -715,902, with Income Tax Benefit (-1,244,430) the largest.
- **Cash and Cash Equivalents 713,481 at Jun 2026, -215,543 vs May 2026 and -1,871,836 vs six months earlier (2,585,317).** Liabilities were 1,002,176, up from 747,583 in May 2026.
- **Dec 2025 single-month items:** Stock-Based Compensation Expense 334,661 (typical month 0), Bonus 80,343 (typical month 2,721) and the Income Tax Benefit above each appear to be single-month items; reviewer to confirm. Earlier spikes flagged on the same basis: Events & Conferences in Feb 2025 (89,275) and Mar 2025 (69,277), and 3rd Party Content Syndication in Jan 2025 (61,225).
